title: Principal Relationship
description: The seller's commercial relationship with the authenticated caller, as get_principal reports it. Present when a relationship or an application exists; omitted when the seller has no relationship with the caller and no application in progress, as for an identity-established caller (docs/building/by-layer/L1/security.mdx#web-bot-auth-identities). See docs/protocol/get_principal.mdx#relationship-status.

expires_at.description: When the relationship lapses unless renewed. Absent means no scheduled expiry. principal.changed fires with reason relationship_expiring at a seller-chosen lead time before this instant.

setup.description: The caller's next step while status is pending_approval, in the same shape as sync_accounts setup. Specific to the authenticated caller, never seller-wide.

url.description: URL where a human at the buyer completes the step.

message.description: Human-readable description of what is needed.

waiting_on.description: Experimental (account.requests). Whose turn it is: seller (application under review) or buyer (a human must complete url). Same meaning as pending-action.json.

kind.description: What is needed. Same meaning as pending-action.json.
